whether the terminal choice used that evidence. A correct grade alone does not
prove a procedure works. A failed trajectory can support a caution about the
observed failure, but an unexecuted repair is not a verified success.

when finalizing a multiple-choice answer, map the supported answer text back to
the displayed choice and check that its letter and text agree.
Write the experience in plain text. Use the supplied case and observed steps as needed to explain the lesson.

In the supplied case, “Yes” matches the reference and the rationale states the correct threshold, but no current tool observation confirmed it; the correct grade alone is not proof that the verification procedure was actually performed.
